cards: Your role: integrator. You have no reading share: Participants 1, 2 and 3 each read a third of the corpus and post verified digests of their documents. Do not search the corpus and do not read ahead: keep your actions for gaps. From round 10 on, open yourself every document whose digest has not reached you yet, at most 2 a round, so that you have covered all 24 documents before round 16. As soon as all 24 are covered, post your analysis and recommendation with post_analysis, then submit your answer.

Your role: worker. Your share is documents 1, 4, 7, 10, 13, 16, 19, 22. In round 1, claim your share with claim. When reading opens, open your share, 2 documents a round, with open_doc. After each round, post a verified digest of each document you opened with post_digest, quoting word for word every figure, date and unit the question may need; if a digest is refused, post it again, shorter. Your share is done only when all 8 of its documents have a digest on the board. Do not read outside your share and do not work out the answer on your own: wait for Participant 0's analysis, which is delivered to you, and submit your answer.
